description:
Ride Play. Repeat. Keep it in the family with the Rossignol Mandate Junior 20-inch mountain bike. Built for young riders 120–135 cm tall, it brings kids right into the heart of the action with a trail-ready aluminum frame and full suspension. Tuned specifically for lighter riders, 120 mm of air-sprung travel front and rear delivers a plush, responsive ride, making every berm, root and drop feel like child's play.

Optimized Fit & Sizing
Engineered for young riders aged 9 to 12 between 135cm and 150cm, this 24-inch frame features a low stand-over height for easy handling. It delivers the perfect balance of stability and safety, allowing growing shredders to master more aggressive terrain with total independence

Optimized Fit & Sizing
Designed for riders aged 7 to 9 and between 120cm and 135cm, this 20-inch powerhouse features a low stand-over height for easy handling.

100% Rossignol All-Mountain Geometry
Developed entirely in-house, the aluminum alloy frame features a unique kinematic inspired by our adult Heretic model. With 120mm of travel, it delivers remarkable agility and the stability needed to build high-speed confidence on any terrain.

Performance Suspension Tuned for Kids
Experience a plush, fluid ride with the 120mm Manitou fork and custom-tuned DVO rear shock. Our specific kinematics ensure the suspension works natively for junior weights right out of the box, delivering high-level performance and adjustable settings without the need to under-inflate.

Trail-Ready Traction
Equipped with Full Maxxis tires, the Mandate Junior 20" provides elite-level grip, allowing kids to corner with precision and tackle technical climbs with ease.
